profile_domain_rationale: Common three-action measured interpolation lower bound and previously approved training-peak study upper bound; not selected from validation outcomes.

slices_extended_manual.performance_score: 100 times frozen composite QoS; explicit substitution for the paper's different polynomial KPI performance score
slices_extended_manual.energy_score: 100*(profile_global_max_power-power)/(profile_global_max_power-profile_global_min_power), bounded to [0,100] as specified for this utility only; physical predictions unchanged
slices_extended_manual.normalization: Global across all three actions on the fixed profiling grid, computed before workload evaluation
slices_extended_manual.tie_break: Lowest action integer, DPDK then USR1 then USR2
slices_extended_manual.regions: Upper envelope of three utilities; refine adjacent winning-action changes by bracketed root finding. Never force a USR2 region or order thresholds.
slices_extended_manual.hysteresis: Hold the executed action unless forecast is strictly more than 26 Mbps inside each finite boundary of the winning region; domain endpoints are not crossover boundaries. Jumping across multiple regions is allowed. Overlapping bands retain executed action.
slices_extended_manual.hold_down: Shared actuator only: change at t permits next at t+4; no duplicate internal timer
slices_extended_manual.selection: No fitted/tuned control parameters, no workload or PPO outcomes used

strong_rule_stage4.improved_variant: Not selected or executed. A reward-aligned one-step proposal is documented separately; no unapproved development selection criterion is invented.

comcom_historical.canonical_source: main:scripts/evaluation_baseline-rule.py inline ranking, also present in publication compiler; not RuleBasedSelector.decide
comcom_historical.adaptation: Replace historical lookup outcomes with exact frozen revision inference. Keep mixed utility scales, binary choices and no hysteresis. Common actuator replaces equivalent loop cooldown, with blocked requests explicitly counted.

development_selection: No baseline improvement search or training-only tuning performed; three primary definitions frozen before evaluation
